name: Hamelin
source:
Initial Class: Necromancer

The tenth Chishiki Girl who appears as a secret boss in the first area of the first game. After beating her, she joins the team. Hameln is brash and loud, referring to herself as the Demon King, though her slur will occasionally mess up her words. Her struggle in articulating ideas disrupts the aura of fear she attempts to convey. For some reason, she's fixated on [url=/c57579]Alice[/url], calling her "m'lady" and abiding by her words with stuttering obedience.
translation:
Initial Class: Necromancer

The tenth Chishiki Girl who appears as a secret boss in the first area of the first game. After beating her, she joins the team. Hameln is brash and loud, referring to herself as the Demon King, though her slur will occasionally mess up her words. Her struggle in articulating ideas disrupts the aura of fear she attempts to convey. For some reason, she's fixated on [url=/c57579]Alice[/url], calling her "m'lady" and abiding by her words with stuttering obedience.
